data.title: Revolution M Alhassan Yusuf called up to Nigeria National Team | New England Revolution
data.content: FOXBOROUGH, Mass. (November 9, 2026) – New England Revolution midfielder Alhassan Yusuf has been selected for international duty by the Nigeria Men's National Team for its upcoming Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers. The 24-player roster convenes this week ahead of two AFCON qualifying matches against Tanzania, Friday, November 13 at home and Tuesday, November 17 away. [...] Through the first two matches of AFCON qualifying action in Group L, Nigeria sits second in the group with three points, having defeated Madagascar, 2-1, and falling to Guinea-Bissau, 3-0. Meanwhile, Tanzania is currently last in the group with two losses to begin the qualifying campaign. [...] Yusuf, 26, enters the November window with 10 senior caps and two international goals to his credit, both coming in his last appearance with Nigeria in May, a 3-0 win over Jamaica. During that spring window, Yusuf also started and played 90 minutes in a victory over Zimbabwe. Since his senior national team debut in January 2024, Yusuf has played three teams in FIFA World Cup qualifiers and three times in the 2025 Africa Cup of Nations.

## Kenya seek another upset as Senegal travel to Juba

Kenya face a challenging assignment against Côte d'Ivoire after eliminating Tanzania 5-4 on aggregate in the opening round. [...] Nigeria's encounter with DR Congo is among the standout fixtures, with the Olympic Eagles travelling to Lubumbashi for Friday's first leg before hosting the return match in Ikenne on 17 November.

Nigeria have named a 23-man squad featuring midfielder Daniel Daga, goalkeeper Michael Atata and emerging forward Abdulmuiz Adeleke.

DR Congo coach Guy Bukasa has selected 26 players, although injuries to Faveurdi Bongeli, Messy Manitu and Yohan Mboko have complicated preparations.
